scope: FYH512 lab only; correction A only; no B final corrections

voice_interpretation.candidate_source: automatic replay of the exact 10 frozen ASR events

joint_objective_lexicographic: maximize sum(log1p(landmark score)) plus sum(voice confidence)
stable candidate identity tie-break independent of input order
reliability_policy: A voice anchor cannot reduce landmark coverage; among equal-coverage chains its confidence competes with landmark evidence strength, so a reliable fingerprint is not automatically displaced.
feasibility_proof: detect_constrained_transitions with the same novelty, presences, local corridors, candidate construction and DP as final execution
voice_subset_search: exhaustive over all interpreted voice candidates; no chronological greedy locking
landmark_alternative_search: for each voice subset, enumerate every ordered chain of reliable landmark presences; reject direct conflicts, then adjacent-correction conflicts, then real constrained-DP conflicts; rank feasible chains by the frozen joint objective

landmark_search_bound.on_limit: abort the complete joint selection with explicit abstention; never return or label a truncated result exhaustive
landmark_search_bound.safe_pruning: a candidate without reliable presence is dominated because it affects neither objective, correction, theoretical corridor nor final DP and can only add an ordering restriction
